note:
Reviewed CDB90 match 176, pinned revision e0b35ec4d798cec3bb4e6970c0f6bb7aa69e2f4c. CDB90 (CAA Database of Battles, Version 1990), tidy data maintained by Jeffrey B. Arnold. Original US Army Concepts Analysis Agency data; revised data licensed ODC-BY. Original force designations and strength interpretations are retained with each quantity. Each side is one aggregate force, including any coalition; its total is not allocated among members. Personnel casualties are not deaths. Source estimates and adjudged error margins are not statistical confidence intervals. Equipment and tactical movements are not established by this dataset. Match review: US ARMY OF THE SOUTHWEST maps directly to the existing Army of the Southwest. The opposing CS ARMY is compatible with the existing Confederate Army of the West, but Q4794361 has kind unknown; preserve a local military force rather than silently reclassifying that participant.

Reviewed equipment analogy for the infantry component of the recorded Union and Confederate forces. The long-arm figure is illustrative; it does not establish an exact regiment, uniform, weapon inventory, or the proportion of infantry in either force.
